Spanning 3,897 square feet, this four-bedroom residence, thoughtfully conceived by Studio Sofield, is gracefully positioned on the Upper East Side, offering sweeping views over Carl Schurz Park and the East River. From this remarkable vantage point, enjoy the tranquil setting of the East River and the lush greenery of Carl Schurz Park. A private entry vestibule, finished with elegant hand-clipped marble mosaic flooring and a stone-trimmed portal, offers direct elevator access and introduces this expansive home. Oversized, acoustically rated windows frame the picturesque park views, while 10' ceilings enhance the grand scale throughout. The windowed open kitchen is a statement of contemporary design, with custom Poliform millwork, sleek metal flush-panel cabinetry, and state-of-the-art Gaggenau appliances. The living room-sized primary suite is a serene retreat, complete with floor-to-ceiling Poliform wardrobe closets outfitting an oversized, windowed walk-in closet. The luxurious primary bath features high ceilings, oversized windows, separate vanities, a free-standing Studio Sofield designed tub, and generous shower and private water closet behind nickel-framed fluted glass. Additional bedrooms are generously proportioned, each offering en-suite bathrooms with radiant floor heating. Unprecedented in new development and thoughtfully integrated throughout each residence is the Ketra ultra-premium lighting system by Lutron, providing fully adjustable light temperature and brightness, along with optional circadian rhythm programming for optimal comfort and wellness. A discreet service entrance opens to a separate utility room equipped with two sets of full-size washers and dryers, millwork and a sink, enhancing both functionality and privacy. This exceptional residence represents a singular offering within one of New York City's most celebrated architectural landmarks. The building will feature 21st-century amenities designed and appointed by Studio Sofield, including a state-of-the-art wellness center exquisitely conceived with an oversized fitness center and dedicated areas for private training, strength and cardio workouts, a sports simulator and lounge, a 60-foot lap pool, and a cold plunge with adjacent sauna for thermal contrast therapy. Residents may also enjoy sweeping views of Carl Schurz Park and the East River from the mezzanine-level billiards room and piano lounge. Private storage and wine cellars are available for purchase. Occupancy this fall.

Featured in the New York Times "On the Market" section, this sprawling coop unit is one-of-a-kind. Offering a double wide living space, the layouts are endless. Situated right where Museum Mile, Central Park East, and Madison Avenue meet, the apartment feels warm and inviting with limestone walls, original hardwood floors, and a vintage clawfoot tub. At the same time, the renovated kitchen, upgraded electrical system, and double-pane windows bring in all the conveniences of today's living. The windowed eat-in kitchen has plenty of space to cook and gather. It features sleek cabinetry, a tall breakfast bar, and a European-style washer/dryer combo. The kitchen flows right into the expansive living room—with yes, four south-facing windows—this has been utilized as a living room and a home office and lounge. What was once a second bedroom, now has been decked out with custom cabinetry, a pull-out desk, and a built-in chaise lounge. Around the corner, the bedroom offers more limestone walls, a north-facing window, and a full-size closet. Off the entry foyer, the windowed bathroom blends modern fixtures with classic charm, including its original clawfoot tub. Upstairs, residents share a rooftop with sweeping 360-degree views—perfect for morning coffee or evening sunsets. Other building perks include caged storage (available for a small monthly fee), a bike room, stroller and scooter storage, a card-operated laundry room, and video intercom. Pets are welcome in this close-knit community of 25 units. The neighborhood has everything you need just steps away—renowned restaurants like Le Bernardin, Eleven Madison Park, and The Modern, plus Whole Foods is only a block over. Fitness options abound, with Equinox, SoulCycle, and Barry's Bootcamp all nearby. And commuting is easy with the 4, 5, 6 Lexington line and Second Avenue Q subway lines just minutes away.
